description.en: The village green: Old Wilf's bench under the old oak, the village pump, the stone cottages and the church, Harry's ball and his goals, a bicycle, the flowers and the sun, and on summer evenings the fête with the brass band.
description.sl: Vaška zelenica: klop starega Wilfa pod starim hrastom, vaška črpalka, kamnite hišice in cerkev, Harryjeva žoga in njegovi goli, kolo, rože in sonce, poleti zvečer pa vaški praznik s pihalno godbo.
description.it: Il prato del paese: la panchina del vecchio Wilf sotto la vecchia quercia, la pompa del paese, le casette di pietra e la chiesa, il pallone di Harry e i suoi gol, una bicicletta, i fiori e il sole, e d'estate la sera la festa con la banda.
description.de: Die Dorfwiese: die Bank des alten Wilf unter der alten Eiche, die Dorfpumpe, die Steinhäuschen und die Kirche, Harrys Ball und seine Tore, ein Fahrrad, die Blumen und die Sonne, und an Sommerabenden das Dorffest mit der Blaskapelle.

words.example_en: Old Wilf sits under the oak.
words.example_it: Il vecchio Wilf siede sotto la quercia.
words.example_de: Der alte Wilf sitzt unter der Eiche.
words.note: An oak lives for hundreds of years, and acorns grow on it.
words.note_sl: Hrast živi več sto let, na njem pa rastejo želodi (acorns).
words.note_it: La quercia vive centinaia di anni, e ci crescono le ghiande (acorns).
words.note_de: Eine Eiche wird Hunderte Jahre alt, und an ihr wachsen Eicheln (acorns).

words.note: After ch the plural takes -es: bench, benches.
words.note_sl: Za ch ima množina -es: bench, benches.
words.note_it: Dopo ch il plurale prende -es: bench, benches.
words.note_de: Nach ch bekommt der Plural -es: bench, benches.

words.note: Play football, with no the; but kick the ball, catch the ball.
words.note_sl: Play football (igrati nogomet) brez the; ampak kick the ball (brcniti žogo), catch the ball (ujeti žogo).
words.note_it: Play football (giocare a calcio) senza the; ma kick the ball (calciare il pallone), catch the ball (prendere la palla).
words.note_de: Play football (Fußball spielen) ohne the; aber kick the ball (den Ball schießen), catch the ball (den Ball fangen).

words.example_en: Mrs Hartley gets water at the pump.
words.example_sl: Gospa Hartley natoči vodo pri črpalki.
words.example_it: La signora Hartley prende l'acqua alla pompa.
words.example_de: Mrs Hartley holt Wasser an der Pumpe.
words.note: The old village pump: move the handle up and down, and the water comes out of the spout.
words.note_sl: Stara vaška črpalka: ročico premikaš gor in dol, voda pa priteče iz cevi.
words.note_it: La vecchia pompa del paese: muovi la leva su e giù, e l'acqua esce dal beccuccio.
words.note_de: Die alte Dorfpumpe: den Schwengel auf und ab bewegen, und das Wasser kommt aus dem Auslauf.

words.example_en: There are three stone cottages on the green.
words.example_sl: Ob zelenici so tri kamnite hišice.
words.example_it: Sul prato ci sono tre casette di pietra.
words.example_de: An der Dorfwiese stehen drei Steinhäuschen.
words.note: A small old house in the country, often of stone, with a little garden.
words.note_sl: Majhna stara hiša na podeželju, pogosto iz kamna, z vrtičkom.
words.note_it: Una piccola casa vecchia in campagna, spesso di pietra, con un giardinetto.
words.note_de: Ein kleines altes Haus auf dem Land, oft aus Stein, mit einem Gärtchen.

words.example_en: Harry rides his bicycle to the lake.
words.example_sl: Harry se s kolesom pelje do jezera.
words.example_it: Harry va al lago in bicicletta.
words.example_de: Harry fährt mit dem Fahrrad zum See.
words.note: Most people say bike. Ride a bike; come by bike.
words.note_sl: Večina reče bike. Ride a bike: voziti kolo; by bike: s kolesom.
words.note_it: Quasi tutti dicono bike. Ride a bike: andare in bici; by bike: in bici.
words.note_de: Die meisten sagen bike. Ride a bike: Rad fahren; by bike: mit dem Rad.

words.example_en: In spring there are daffodils in the flower bed.
words.example_it: In primavera nell'aiuola ci sono i narcisi.
words.example_de: Im Frühling blühen Narzissen im Blumenbeet.
words.note: Flour (for bread) sounds just the same as flower!
words.note_sl: Flour (moka) se izgovori čisto enako kot flower!
words.note_it: Flour (farina) si pronuncia proprio come flower!

words.note: The sun is out: it's sunny. In the Lakes people say it with a big smile.
words.note_sl: The sun is out: sonce sije. V Jezernem okrožju to rečejo z velikim nasmehom.
words.note_it: The sun is out: c'è il sole. Nel Distretto dei Laghi lo si dice con un gran sorriso.
words.note_de: The sun is out: die Sonne scheint. Im Lake District sagt man das mit einem breiten Lächeln.

words.example_en: The children drink at the drinking fountain.
words.note: A drinking fountain gives clean water to everyone, for free.
words.note_sl: Pitnik daje čisto vodo vsem, zastonj.
words.note_it: La fontanella dà acqua pulita a tutti, gratis.
words.note_de: Ein Trinkbrunnen gibt allen sauberes Wasser, umsonst.

words.note: Score a goal: kick the ball in. The goal is also the place: two school bags on the grass will do.
words.note_sl: Score a goal: zabiti gol. Goal so tudi vrata: dve šolski torbi na travi sta dovolj.
words.note_it: Score a goal: segnare un gol. Goal è anche la porta: due cartelle sull'erba bastano.
words.note_de: Score a goal: ein Tor schießen. Goal ist auch das Tor selbst: zwei Schultaschen im Gras reichen.

words.example_en: The children play on the village green.
words.example_sl: Otroci se igrajo na vaški zelenici.
words.example_it: I bambini giocano sul prato del paese.
words.example_de: Die Kinder spielen auf der Dorfwiese.
words.note: The green: the grass in the middle of an English village. It belongs to everyone.
words.note_sl: The green: trata sredi angleške vasi. Je od vseh.
words.note_it: The green: il prato in mezzo a un paese inglese. È di tutti.
words.note_de: The green: die Wiese mitten in einem englischen Dorf. Sie gehört allen.

words.example_en: There's a cake stall at the fête.
words.example_sl: Na vaškem prazniku je stojnica s pecivom.
words.example_it: Alla festa del paese c'è una bancarella di dolci.
words.example_de: Auf dem Dorffest gibt es einen Kuchenstand.
words.note: A summer fête: the brass band, cakes, games and a raffle, on a Saturday on the green. Say FATE.
words.note_sl: Poletni fête: pihalna godba, pecivo, igre in srečelov, ob sobotah na zelenici. Izgovori »fejt«.
words.note_it: Una fête d'estate: la banda, i dolci, i giochi e la lotteria, il sabato sul prato. Si pronuncia «feit».
words.note_de: Ein Sommerfest (fête): Blaskapelle, Kuchen, Spiele und Tombola, samstags auf der Dorfwiese. Man sagt »feit«.
